entries.root_cause: A rewrite of the shared deterministic-assurance falsifier preserved only the post-merge host-inventory authority assertions and silently dropped the historical pre-merge block plus the exact successor rule/effect bindings. Because no independent guard still checked implementation_authority_before_merge, accepted authorization history could be rewritten while assurance remained green.

The AI E2E Markdown visibility parser excluded comments, fences, container HTML, and common block tags but still treated headings inside CommonMark processing instructions, CDATA, declarations, and generic raw-tag blocks as rendered semantic structure. Hidden text could therefore impersonate canonical G/S headings.
horizontal_audit: G0-G14 and S0-S10 rendered heading authority

entries.root_cause: The machine-readable AI E2E execution manifest exposed an optimization_target consumed by planning automation but the validator did not bind it to the canonical roadmap objective. The field could drift to throughput, commit count, or another objective while all governance gates stayed green.
